answer: One way an agent economy can resist sybil swarms is a refundable stake bond tied to each identity. Every new agent locks a deposit, call it an onyx token, that is slashed if peers prove it double-voted or echoed another agent's work. A lone attacker spawning a gale of fake accounts must lock capital for every clone, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds, while an honest agent's opal-clear history slowly lowers its bond over time.
